description: The file defines a final class GatewayProcessManager responsible for managing gateway processes, handling their status, environment, log, and connection attempts. It includes functions for starting, stopping, refreshing status, attaching to existing gateways, and launching gateway processes, as well as handling logs and errors.

classes.name: GatewayProcessManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing the lifecycle, status, and environment of a gateway process used for communication within the application. It handles starting, stopping, attaching to existing instances, auto-enabling launch agents, and maintaining logs.

classes.name: Status
classes.description: An enum representing various states of the gateway process: stopped, starting, running, attachedExisting, or failed, each with associated data where relevant.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the desired active state of the gateway process, initiating start or stop procedures accordingly.

methods.name: ensureLaunchAgentEnabledIfNeeded
methods.description: Automatically enables the launch agent for the gateway if it's not already enabled, considering configuration states.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Attempts to start the gateway process if it's not already running, first trying to attach to an existing instance.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the gateway process and disables associated launch agents if applicable.

methods.name: clearLastFailure
methods.description: Clears any stored last failure reason.

methods.name: refreshEnvironmentStatus
methods.description: Refreshes the environment's status, with optional forcing.

methods.name: refreshLog
methods.description: Refreshes the in-memory log from the log file.

methods.name: attachExistingGatewayIfAvailable
methods.description: Attempts to connect to an already running gateway process on the configured port, attaching if successful.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Generates a descriptive string for a gateway instance or health snapshot including port, instance details, and channel info.

methods.name: describe(instance:)
methods.description: Returns a description string for a specific port guardian descriptor.

methods.name: describeAttachFailure
methods.description: Generates a descriptive message for a failed attach attempt based on the error encountered.

methods.name: isGatewayAuthFailure
methods.description: Determines if an error indicates an authentication failure with the gateway.

methods.name: enableLaunchdGateway
methods.description: Enables and waits for the launchd gateway process to become available.

methods.name: appendLog
methods.description: Appends a string chunk to the in-memory log, trimming it if necessary.

methods.name: refreshControlChannelIfNeeded
methods.description: Refreshes the control channel if it's not already connected or degraded.

methods.name: waitForGatewayReady
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for the gateway to become ready within a specified timeout.

methods.name: clearLog
methods.description: Clears the in-memory log and deletes the log file.

methods.name: setProjectRoot
methods.description: Sets the project root path in CommandResolver.

methods.name: projectRootPath
methods.description: Returns the current project root path from CommandResolver.

methods.name: readGatewayLog
methods.description: Reads the gateway log file content up to a limit, returning an empty string if file access fails.
